Map StEIS organisation codes to ODS codes and fetch ODS organisation data

map_steis_org_codes.Rd

A StEIS code can cover several organisations. Supply org_name_col so the organisation name picks the right ODS code. Without it, those codes can't be resolved and are reported according to on_missing.

Usage

map_steis_org_codes(
  data,
  org_code_col,
  org_name_col = NULL,
  english_only = TRUE,
  include_cols = character(),
  on_missing = c("warn", "error", "silent")
)

Arguments

data

A dataframe containing StEIS organisation codes

org_code_col

Column containing organisation code (e.g., 'Reporting Organisation Code')

org_name_col

Column containing the organisation name (e.g., 'Reporting Organisation'), or NULL

english_only

Logical. Filter to include English (and N/A) organisations

include_cols

Character. ODS columns to add (org_name, org_type, org_country, org_region_code, org_region). Default adds none.

on_missing

Character. What to do when codes are ambiguous, not found in ODS, or the request fails: "warn" (default) warns and carries on, "error" stops, "silent" does nothing.

Value

Original dataframe with an ods_org_code column and organisation data joined on
